decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 22MC/2011/P01Rev A and 22MC/2011/P02 Rev A submitted 13 April 2012 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family house known as 22 Mornington Crescent and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and shall not include kitchen or bathroom facilities).
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding in the rear garden
